selectionGuide.description: A sweating decision-maker reaches toward two labeled buttons, turning incompatible options into an anxious dilemma.
bestFor: two mutually exclusive choices that are both costly or embarrassing
conflicting obligations faced by one identifiable decision-maker
an impossible tradeoff whose tension is the punchline
avoidWhen: one option is clearly preferred with no real conflict
the ideas form a cause-and-effect sequence instead of a choice
more than two alternatives need equal treatment

mechanics.visual: The two buttons establish the alternatives, while the sweating figure communicates that choosing either one creates trouble.
mechanics.text: Place parallel options in left and right, then use caption only when naming the conflicted person or group adds necessary context.
